QMines (ASX:QML) has recently acquired 25 freehold parcels surrounding its Mt Chalmers copper‑gold project, expanding its legal ownership of land adjacent to the mine’s operation and access corridors. This purchase strengthens the company’s control over critical infrastructure routes and supports future expansion or development on site by securing additional exploration and mining rights. The move also signals QML’s commitment to regulatory compliance and operational security for stakeholders and investors.
